subject: Montage: deterministic snapshot + tenant cold-start mitigation — sprint slot request
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, Jun 7, 2026 at 09:12 AM -0700
Subject: Montage: deterministic snapshot + tenant cold-start mitigation — sprint slot request

Hi Priyom / Laura,

Quick context: Montage (Alexandra Ortiz) is moving toward a Q4 launch for a new product line and our proposal is at the final negotiation stage — they asked for two feature commitments as a condition of a signed contract:

1) deterministic inference snapshot support (they want a way to pin model+weights+tokenization snapshot for compliance/playback), and
2) tenant cold-start mitigation — they want a contractual SLA around initial request latency during scale-ups (they call it "warmstart guarantees").

Deal impact: this is a ~$650k ARR, multi-year commitment. Procurement has pushed the commercial window to close by end of June; legal will need precise language about what we can/won't commit.

Ask: can Product/Eng evaluate whether we can:
- allocate a sprint slot (2 weeks) in early July for a scoped bridge to deliver a minimal deterministic snapshot capability + a short-term cold-start mitigation (prefill/seed strategy)
- provide a rough engineering estimate and known blockers by EOD Wed (2026-06-09) so I can update Alexandra and procurement

Attachments: I attached the customer MAAP and our current proposed SOW (Montage_MAAP_v1.pdf, montage_prod_requirements.xlsx).

If this is not feasible, please propose the lowest-risk alternative we can commit to in contract language (e.g., "engineering exploration with timeline" or "pilot-level warmpool support by X date").

Thanks — this is time sensitive. Happy to sync 30 min if that's easier.

—Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0112

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, Jun 7, 2026 at 10:46 AM -0700
Subject: Re: Montage: deterministic snapshot + tenant cold-start mitigation — sprint slot request

Ben — thanks for the clear ask and the artifacts. A few immediate clarifying questions before I can give an estimate:

- Deterministic snapshot: do they need snapshotting at the model binary level (exact weights + tokenizer + runtime flags) or a lighter "pinned model config" that maps to a versioned image we already host? Full binary snapshot + playback is heavier (storage + export support + signature verification).

- Warmstart SLA: what concurrency and p99 acceptable latency are they targeting on day-0? Are we talking about very large fan-out (hundreds of tenants) or typical enterprise burst (10s of concurrent sessions)?

Possible short-term options that might reduce scope:
- Offer a managed "pinned model version" feature that guarantees a named image (low effort) instead of full binary snapshot.
- Implement a seed-cache (prefix seeding) for their high-traffic tenants to reduce cold-starts; this could be scoped as a config + task in a single sprint if we avoid changes to persistent KV across hosts.

I can look at a 2-week spike plan and carve the MVP, but I need the QPS / concurrency targets from the customer. Ben — can you push those numbers? If they expect strict deterministic export (for auditability), that will push us out of a one-sprint deliverable.

I'll block time tomorrow to draft an engineering estimate once we have the numbers.

—Priyom
Product Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Montage: deterministic snapshot + tenant cold-start mitigation — sprint slot request

Priyom — thanks. Quick answers from Montage (from Alexandra):

- They prefer a full deterministic snapshot for compliance — must be able to "replay" inference deterministically for a given model version. That said, they're open to a staged promise: commit to a named pinned image today + roadmap the full binary snapshot
- Expected burst: up to 40 concurrent sessions for the initial rollout, with spikes up to ~120 QPS during peak events. P50 target is <150ms for interactive flows; they asked we aim for p95 <400ms even during initial warmups

I've added the HubSpot link and the MAAP in Drive: https://hubspot.redwood/record/MTG-2026-1892 and https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Montage-MDAP-Shared

They explicitly said: "If Redwood can commit to a named pinned image now and a plan/ETA for deterministic snapshots in the contract, we'll sign by June 30." Procurement (procurement@montage.io) is on the thread.

Also attaching their updated SOW redlines (proposal_v2_redlines.docx).

—Ben

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, Jun 9, 2026 at 11:02 AM -0700
Subject: Re: Montage: deterministic snapshot + tenant cold-start mitigation — sprint slot request

Thanks for the context. Engineering perspective:

- Named pinned image ("model version pinning") is low friction: we already have model catalog versioning; we can expose a contractual guarantee that a named image will remain available for N months. Risk: does not provide bitwise determinism across runtime changes.

- Full deterministic snapshot + replay is a larger engineering undertaking. Key blockers: runtime flags that affect tokenization/ops, quantization nondeterminism on some kernels, and storage/export workflow (signed artifact storage). That likely needs a spike + 2 sprint implementation (spike to identify nondeterministic ops and a follow-up to implement export/verify).

- Cold-start mitigation for 40–120 QPS: we can do a seeded prefix cache and tenant affinity warm-pools as a one-sprint MVP if we limit scope to a fixed number of tenant slots and accept manual onboarding. We'll need a short-term config:
  - Seed a small KV prefix per tenant on deployment (scriptable)
  - Reserve 4 warm containers for Montage in dedicated pool for first 3 months (operational cost needs signoff)

Request: if Sales/CS want a contractual commitment, we need to spell out the exact promise and acceptance criteria. Suggest wording options:
  A) "Redwood will provide pinned model images and a product roadmap for deterministic snapshots, with ETA provided within 30 days of contract signature." (lower risk)
  B) "Redwood will deliver deterministic snapshot capability and warm-pool mitigation by MM/DD/YYYY, subject to mutually agreed onboarding tests." (higher risk — engineering ETA required)

I can put together a 2-week spike plan that covers: nondeterminism analysis, infra design for artifact signing, and a cost estimate for reserved warm-pool capacity. Can we schedule a 30-min triage today at 3pm PT? I can have a high-level spike plan and rough estimates by EOD Friday if the numbers above are correct.

—Laura
Engineering Lead, Serving Runtime

Forwarding our proposed path. TL;DR: Redwood can commit to pinned named images now (low-risk) and run a 2-week spike to scope deterministic snapshot effort. For cold-starts we propose a seeded-prefix + small reserved warm-pool as an MVP (operational cost to be included in SOW).

Alexandra / Procurement — can you confirm that a contract that includes option A (pinned image + roadmap + 30-day ETA for snapshot plan) would be acceptable to sign by June 30? If so, I'll work with Legal to draft.

Thanks everyone — looking to lock the commercial window.

—Ben
